title: NYC Private Mafia Tour by Luxury Vehicle
includes: Transport by private luxury vehicle to accommodate your group size
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Based on traffic and weather conditions, not every site may be covered
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: New York City’s historic past is plagued by dark events and powerful criminals who took the law into their own hands. Experience the suspense and thrill of all things gang and mob related on this 4-hour vehicle tour of Manhattan or a 6-hour tour of Manhattan and Queens. All tours include transport by luxury vehicle a professional driver and guide who specializes in the Mafia.
